b.x: Shadow, in this craft

Shadow is not the film villain. It is what the archetype refuses to see in himself — and so it drives from behind. In the gray man, the lucid face watches, keeps, crosses with no stage. The shadow makes the same gesture for another reason: not so the street will not pick him; so he will not pick himself. The move looks like craft. The fuel is familiar fear.
DO
Field question: does this discretion protect me from the street — or hide me from myself? If both, name both. The cape stays. The skin leaves.
Five marks of the prison
1. The alibi. “It is just being gray.” The sentence shuts desire, voice, quiet joy. The craft becomes an excuse not to exist. True discretion leaves a remainder of life. The shadow leaves none.
2. Fear as a house. Not the fear of the interview — that is data. The fear that was already there before the street, that taught vanishing, that asks for proof all day. Magnet. Field 96.

3. “I am fine.” The body contradicts: dry mouth, high shoulder, joy that never arrives, color that scares. Months. This can be depression dressed as balance. The archetype does not diagnose. The clinic does.
4. The pride of not being seen. The shadow also swells. “I see; they do not.” Lucid gray does not need this sentence. Whoever needs it is already on a stage — an inner stage, worse to map.

5. Little miracle. The known corridor: little risk, little color, little gesture Tuesday would already eat. Surviving becomes a ceiling. The high life waits for “after the collapse” — and after does not come.
Return without becoming a poster
01 Name it: is this cape or skin? One line. No paragraph. Field 93.
02 One remainder of life that is not a stage: a quiet color, a voice at home, a small yes that does not report the street.
03 The cape stays in the street. Twelve seconds, emergency numbers, the quiet kit. Nobody needs to know you picked yourself.
04 If the erasure lasts months and the body already voted: the clinic. Emergency care. Shadow is not treated with archetype alone.
NOTE
Integrating the shadow is not confessing in the group. It is giving back to the man what fear swallowed — desire, voice, quiet joy — without handing over the street.
What this field refuses
It does not teach stage Jung, ‘working the shadow’ on a story, an archetype guru.
It does not teach dropping the cape to ‘heal’. The street remains. The skin that leaves is not discretion.
It does not diagnose. Months of erasure, despair, a wish to vanish for real: emergency care, the clinic.
It is not militia, not evasion, not ‘I see and they are cattle’.
It teaches only this: the gray’s shadow is using the craft in order not to pick yourself. The cape stays. The skin leaves. Field 98. The magnet: 96. Tuesday stays yours.
